A REJECTED FILL IS NOT A ZERO: the position leaves its group and is counted under rejected_entry, rejected_exit, unbarred or below_board_minimum, because a zero is a return and a group in which every locked name reads flat is a group whose return is partly a measurement of the lock rate. That biases the survivors and the direction is named rather than argued away (a_group_return_is_conditioned_on_the_names_that_could_be_traded). (4) THREE TIERS. Inherited whole from factor_ic's TIER_ADMITTED_CODES rather than restated, so imputed values still do not enter and the import-time reconciliation still runs once. (5) DIRECTION. Consistent with V2-P3-005 and with one difference forced by the arithmetic: group 0 is always the lowest RAW factor value so a stored table stays diffable, and the declaration decides which group is LONG rather than the sign of a number -- a correlation can be negated and a portfolio cannot. long_short_spread is the exact negation of raw_spread under lower_is_better, bit for bit. (6) LONG-SHORT AND 融券. The spread is delivered and is named as a difference between two LONG portfolios, not a shortable return, and the reason is contract-level rather than an omission: ExecutionRequest has no short side, A-share securities lending is an eligible list at a broker rate with inventory this repository holds no dataset for, and KNOWN_EXECUTION_LIMITATIONS.a_one_price_session_refuses_one_side_here_and_both_ends_there already records that the policy and the label agree on the buy side of the entry and the sell side of the exit AND NOT ON THE OTHER TWO -- which is exactly the short round trip, with the policy fail-open where the label refuses. MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: a whole-market period is 35.9 ms for 5,534 securities' round trips (best of seven), the same order as apply_factor_transform's 35.9-37.6 ms over the same 5,534 and 62x smaller than the 2.24 s compute_factor read before it, so ADR-0003's answer is unchanged and runtime dependencies remain nine; the 5-yuan minimum commission binds below 16,666.67 yuan of notional and puts a round trip's drag at 0.1520% against an asymptote of 0.1120%, 35.7% more cost for the same trade, which is why position_capital is declared and carried rather than defaulted. THE NEUTRALISED TIER IS READ AT A YEAR-END SNAPSHOT and carries V2-P3-005's own code for it; V2-P4-026 is the fix and is a hard precondition of V2-P4-013.

feature_name: Correlation and redundancy analysis: arithmetic identity separated from empirical correlation, over factor values, factor ranks and IC series
feature_description: V2-P3-008's standard-library leaf over the nineteen shipped factors' 171 pairs. Three readings of 'redundancy', because they mean different things and have different remedies: the cross-sectional PEARSON correlation of two factors' values at one as_of, the cross-sectional SPEARMAN correlation of their average ranks (the reading that matters for anything selecting on a factor, since a book is built from an ordering), and the TIME-SERIES correlation of two ICPoint.ic series at one horizon (do the two work on the same days -- which a cross-sectionally orthogonal pair can still fail). The sign is oriented by BOTH factors' declared FactorDefinition.direction, so positive always means 'these two make the same bet', and the redundancy verdict is judged on the magnitude, so it is direction-free. Four verdicts in one ladder: arithmetic (a DECLARED FactorIdentity naming both factors was EVALUATED on these values and its residual came in within its own declared tolerance), undeclared_lockstep (round(abs(r), 15) == 1.0 and nothing declared explains it), redundant (abs(r) at or above the DECLARED redundancy_threshold), distinct. SharedInputs is computed from FactorDefinition.required_fields alone -- no data, no partition, no as_of -- and reports identical_inputs / overlapping_inputs / shared_dataset_only / disjoint_inputs beside the shared qualified columns themselves. A pair may name one factor on two tiers, which is how much of a factor survived its neutralisation. Reuses factor_ic's average_ranks, _pearson, TIER_ADMITTED_CODES (imputed still excluded) and MINIMUM_IC_AS_OFS rather than restating them; there is no layering boundary between two modules of backtest/, so a second copy would be unforced duplication.
notes: SEVEN JUDGEMENTS, EACH MEASURED OR DECLARED WITH ITS COST. (1) THE ARITHMETIC HALF AND THE STRUCTURAL HALF NEED DIFFERENT MACHINERY, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS COMPUTABLE. A shared panel column is derivable from required_fields with no data at all; an identity such as 1 + m20 == (1 + m15) * (1 + r5) is not visible there at all, because required_fields names the columns and not the arithmetic. So SharedInputs is COMPUTED and FactorIdentity is DECLARED-THEN-EVALUATED: verify_identity runs the declared residual on the values in hand and answers verified / refuted / unevaluable with max_abs_residual reported under every code, and RedundancyPoint's validator refuses the arithmetic verdict on anything but a verified check. A declaration nothing measured cannot reach a stored report. V2-P3-012's identity is declared ONCE in the tests and evaluated TWICE off the shipped evaluators on 40 securities with independently drawn session returns: against an unskipped 20-session momentum it is verified at a residual of 4.4e-16 and the pair is filed arithmetic at a rank correlation of +0.26; against the SHIPPED momentum_20_sessions on the same price paths and the same declaration it is refuted at 1.7e-01, fifteen orders of magnitude larger, and the pair falls to the empirical ladder at -0.03. That is 012's five-session skip measured rather than inherited as prose. (2) THE STRUCTURAL CODE IS MEASURED NOT TO DECIDE THE VERDICT, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, ON THE LIVE REGISTRY. Of the 171 shipped pairs, 42 share at least one qualified column, 72 share at least one DATASET, and 16 declare IDENTICAL required_fields -- all three derived from FACTOR_DEFINITIONS rather than tabulated, so the twentieth factor moves them and the test is where that shows. NOT SUFFICIENT: momentum_120_sessions and reversal_5_sessions are one of the 16 identical pairs and V2-P3-012 built them so the sessions each multiplies are disjoint; the test exhibits TWO pairs under the one identical_inputs code coming out distinct and undeclared_lockstep. NOT NECESSARY: return_on_equity_ttm and accruals_ttm share NO qualified column -- income.n_income_attr_p against income.n_income, two profit lines V2-P3-011 measured giving different growth rates on 139 of 181 comparable pairs -- which CORRECTS the informal claim that the pair shares TTM net profit. What they share is the income and balancesheet datasets, which is why shared_dataset_only is its own code: a dataset reading finds 71% more overlap than a column reading and would call the value and quality families related by construction. (3) THE REDUNDANCY THRESHOLD IS DECLARED AND THE LOCKSTEP BOUNDARY IS NOT A THRESHOLD. redundancy_threshold has NO default and the module refuses to choose one, for FactorICSpec.min_securities' reason sharpened by this issue's own hazard: a number chosen after seeing nineteen factors is a number chosen to make them look separated. Only the declaration is bounded, and both bounds are arithmetic -- gt=0 because abs(r) >= 0 always so a zero threshold calls every pair redundant, le=1 because 1.0 is attainable (_pearson clamps to the closed range) and is the strictest legal declaration. The lockstep rung is NOT declared: round(abs(r), 15) == 1.0 is factor_ic's own measured rule for 'this correlation is one at the last bit', re-measured here in BOTH directions -- 200 of 200 exact affine images and 200 of 200 exact monotone images clear it while plain == 1.0 clears only 149 and 153 of them, and 200 of 200 vectors perturbed by N(0, 0.001) noise (largest abs(r) 0.9999998220801101) do NOT. All five counts are asserted BY VALUE off a declared seed rather than as inequalities, because ''fewer than 200 cleared plain equality'' is satisfied by 199 and by 0 and those are the opposite findings. (4) THE SAMPLE FLOOR IS FOUR AND THE EXTRA ONE OVER MINIMUM_IC_SECURITIES IS ARITHMETIC. At n = 3 there are six permutations of three ranks and 1 - 6*sum(d^2)/24 takes exactly four values over them, so an untied rank correlation of three securities is +-0.5 or +-1 and NOTHING else: no threshold at or below 0.5 distinguishes anything and none above it admits more than the perfectly ordered pair. n = 4 is the first size at which a rank correlation of exactly 0 is attainable. Enumerated over all 6 and all 24 permutations rather than sampled. Pearson reaches 0 at n = 3 ((0,1,2) against (0,1,0)), so the floor is set by the weaker of the two methods the module offers. (5) NO SIGNIFICANCE, ON THREE SEPARATE GROUNDS RATHER THAN ONE BORROWED. factor_ic publishes no t-statistic because a daily IC series over overlapping windows is not independent draws; the question was asked again here and answered no three times. A cross section's n is not a sample size (the securities share a market factor, an industry and a size exposure -- exactly what panel_neutralization regresses out -- so a p-value against n = 5,534 would measure the market's commonality); a SERIES of cross-sectional correlations is autocorrelated because exposures are persistent, so stdev_correlation understates the sampling error of mean_correlation; and an IC-series correlation inherits the overlapping windows whole, on both sides at once. Three named KNOWN_REDUNDANCY_LIMITATIONS codes, not one. A fourth records that a CROSS-TIER pair is MORE exposed to the year-end-snapshot defect than a single-tier one, because it puts a point-in-time side and a snapshot side into one number -- narrower than factor_ic's own entry and therefore its own. (6) THE 6.3x OPTIMISATION IS WRONG AND THE MODULE PAYS FOR NOT TAKING IT. Ranking each factor once and correlating the stored rank vectors turns the 171-pair matrix from 0.860 s into 0.137 s at n = 5,534 -- and a rank is a position within a SET, so the ranks of a subset are not the subset of the ranks. Two factors are admitted for different subjects whenever their coverage differs, which is the ordinary case; restricting a 40-name rank vector to a 25-name intersection and correlating disagreed with the honest answer on 200 of 200 random trials, by as much as 0.100. So _correlate ranks inside each pair's own intersection. ADR-0003's V2-P3-008 update carries the whole measurement: one pair 4.97 ms through the module against factor_ic's 3.56 ms bare, the 171-pair matrix 0.398 s at pearson and 0.860 s at spearman, a year of daily whole-market matrices 210 s -- inside the range of a SINGLE write_panel_batch (56.7 s to 617.9 s). That is NOT the 630x headroom V2-P3-005 reported and the section says so rather than smoothing it. Nine runtime dependencies unchanged; the eigen-decomposition a risk model would want is explicitly NOT covered by this measurement. (7) NO IDENTITY SHIPS, AND THAT IS A DECLARATION RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. RedundancyStudy takes identities as a REQUIRED keyword argument with no default, so there is no module-level registry that could empty itself out while every per-identity assertion passed vacuously -- FactorRegistry's own refused shape, and worse here, because an empty identity registry does not merely check nothing: it makes every arithmetic pair in the build look empirical. Among the nineteen there is no exact two-member relation to declare; the growth family comes closest and revenue_yoy_acceleration == revenue_yoy - YoY(P-4) has a third term that is not a shipped factor. undeclared_lockstep is the backstop rather than the detector, and its limitation entry says so: no part of this module can DISCOVER an identity nobody declared. MUTATIONS: twenty-nine mutations of the implementation were each confirmed to turn the new tests red -- the arithmetic verdict accepting any identity, the arithmetic verdict accepting a refuted one, the identity tolerance comparison inverted, an unevaluable check reported as verified, relates() weakened from both to either, the orientation applying the left direction only, the orientation dropped, lower_is_better signing +1, the lockstep boundary moved to 14 and to 16 places, the redundancy comparison made strict, the declared threshold replaced by a constant, the intersection walked in the left vector's order rather than sorted, spearman ranking the whole vector before restricting, the two degenerate sides swapped, the sample floor lowered to 3, shared_inputs compared at dataset granularity, identical_inputs collapsed into overlapping_inputs, the summary's arithmetic rung weakened from all to any, the summary verdict decided by the signed mean, imputed values admitted, the vector census arithmetic disabled, the IC series correlating raw_ic, a cross-tier self pair refused, the residual's non-negativity guard removed, shared_columns reporting datasets, the identity dropped from its own point, and each of the two point validators disabled. THE FIRST ROUND CAUGHT 19 OF 26 AND THE THREE REAL SURVIVORS EACH BOUGHT A TEST: the inclusive threshold comparison needed a pair landing EXACTLY on a declared line (0.7999999999999998, the value five ranks produce for (0,2,1,4,3)), the sorted intersection needed the two sides' rows offered in DIFFERENT orders (two dicts built from one subject tuple share an insertion order and the mutation was invisible), and the magnitude-not-signed-mean rung needed three days at +0.964/+0.964/-0.964. PER-FIELD TAMPERING: every reported field of the four stored contracts was corrupted one at a time -- 18 on RedundancyPoint, 17 on RedundancySummary, 6 on IdentityCheck and 11 on ICSeriesCorrelation, 52 in total. THE FIRST ROUND LEFT 11 UNDETECTED at 100% line coverage, which is V2-P3-005's seven reproducing on this plane: both keys on RedundancyPoint, all four identifiers on RedundancySummary, IdentityCheck.code and max_abs_residual, and both factor ids and the horizon on ICSeriesCorrelation. max_abs_residual is the one that changed the CONTRACT rather than only a test: the corruption turned 4.4e-16 into -1e-3, which cleared every positive tolerance and read as verified, so the field now refuses a negative value outright -- it is a maximum of absolute values and a negative one cannot have come from verify_identity. All 52 are caught now, and the harness carries its own control run (an unpatched field must be green and a known-detected one must be red), because the first tampering harness reported 52 of 52 while every run was failing on an ImportError.

feature_name: Factor turnover, coverage and capacity: the report that makes a statistically attractive and unimplementable signal visible
feature_description: V2-P3-007's tradeability report as a standard-library leaf over V2-P3-006's PeriodPortfolio and V2-P3-005's own ICCrossSection, plus one caller-supplied fact no backtest/ contract holds: a session's turnover in yuan. The issue's one-line brief is the acceptance criterion -- make the signals that are statistically attractive and not implementable visible -- so every number is chosen for its ability to separate two factors whose IC is identical. COVERAGE IS A FOUR-STEP FUNNEL WHOSE STEPS HAVE FOUR DIFFERENT OWNERS: universe -> valued is the factor engine's, valued -> admissible is the tier's own admission policy (TIER_ADMITTED_CODES), admissible -> scored is domain/labels.py's (halt, limit lock, unpublished band, delisting) and scored -> held is AShareExecutionPolicy's; implementable_rate is held/universe, the product of the four to within the rounding of four divisions. The two middle steps are what a single coverage number loses, and the two tier tables are imported rather than restated with BOTH load-bearing -- recovering valued_count means walking the tier's whole vocabulary keeping the cells that carry a value and are not admitted, which is one table each, and they differ in exactly one cell across all three tiers (processed's imputed). THE PER-GROUP DECOMPOSITION IS THE ACCEPTANCE CRITERION'S INSTRUMENT and it survives the code it exists for: under unfillable_after_execution PeriodPortfolio.groups is empty, so the counts are derived as assigned-minus-rejected and under measured the two readings are required to agree. TURNOVER IS A ROLLING PORTFOLIO OVER THE LONG GROUP AND THE REBALANCE FREQUENCY IS NOT A NEW PARAMETER: it is the spacing of the as_ofs the caller already offered, measured here rather than declared, and a schedule whose windows overlap is reported as overlapping_schedule because a name carried across two overlapping windows is held twice rather than once. Turnover is published on names and on money, both symmetric over the two ends because the two ends are not the same size, and the two differ because V2-P3-006's positions are equal in budget and lot-rounded. The saving is taken from ExecutionResults that already exist -- for each retained name the earlier period's exit fee and the later period's entry fee -- so no order is simulated and no price is invented, and round_trip_cost with round_trip_cost - avoided_cost bracket what a rolling portfolio pays. NO ROLLING RETURN IS PUBLISHED: a retained position between exit_day(k-1) and entry_day(k) is held across sessions no label window covers, and chaining the covered ones is the compounding V2-P3-006 already refuses. CAPACITY IS ONE DECLARED JUDGEMENT AND THE REST IS ARITHMETIC: participation_cap has no default, is a constraint and not an impact model (CostSchedule has no size term and this repository holds no dataset an impact coefficient could be fitted on), the session's turnover is the caller's and must be dated at or before the entry day, and the min binds because V2-P3-006's equal-budget sizing forces it -- capital_multiple below 1.0 says the declared position_capital is already over capacity.
notes: THE ACCEPTANCE DEMONSTRATION. One cross section of twelve securities with a rank correlation of 0.9999999999999998, run against two markets: one suspends the three highest-scored names' entry sessions and the other the three lowest. The correlation cannot tell them apart because a MarketBar is not one of its inputs, AND NEITHER CAN THE PERIOD-LEVEL FUNNEL -- both refuse three of twelve so execution_rate is 0.75 in each and every count above it is identical, which the test asserts as bad.funnel == good.funnel. What separates them is one row of one table: the long group's own execution rate is 0.25 against 1.0 and top_group_execution_shortfall is +0.5 against -0.25. The sharper case is a long group the market refuses entirely, where the period is V2-P3-006's unfillable_after_execution with groups == () and the per-group table is still there -- which is why the shortfall is a DIFFERENCE rather than a ratio, since min_securities_per_group of 1 makes the zero denominator reachable. THE CAPACITY ASSUMPTIONS, EACH DECLARED OR NAMED: participation_cap is a declared parameter with no default in (0, 1]; position_capital is inherited from QuantilePortfolioSpec rather than re-declared; the session turnover is a caller input whose unit is in the field name; the liquidity session is the caller's, must be at or before the entry day and must be one session for the whole period, with liquidity_day reported beside entry_day; CNY_PER_TURNOVER_UNIT = 1000 is a hard-coded constant measured 11/11 on real rows and pinned against panel_factors.CNY_PER_AMOUNT_UNIT by a test because backtest/ may not import the panel plane; one session and one fill is hard-coded because that is what AShareExecutionPolicy does; the min binding is forced by the equal-budget sizing rather than chosen; and two limitations name what is not modelled -- capacity_is_estimated_on_the_entry_leg_only, which deliberately claims NO direction for the error because nothing in this repository measures how a name's entry-session turnover relates to its exit-session turnover, and naming a bias nobody measured is the shape of every Critical finding taken here and capacity_is_a_declared_participation_cap_and_not_a_market_impact_model. MEASURED ON REAL PUBLISHED TURNOVER: 000001.SZ's 2026-06-12 session traded 2,263,042,930.57 yuan and 000569.SZ's 2001-01-02 session 6,579,577.80, a factor of 344, so a group holding both is capped by the second and at a 1% participation cap that name absorbs 65,795.78 yuan -- V2-P3-006's own 100,000-yuan test position is a capital_multiple of 0.658, over capacity before a single fee is counted. NARROW SAMPLES ARE DECLARED RATHER THAN FLOORED AGAIN: a turnover between two groups of n counts in units of 1/2n so a three-name group has seven attainable values, which Rebalance.resolution reports beside every ratio, and a capacity is one security's turnover however many the group holds, which binding_subject names. No second sample floor is imposed because QuantilePortfolioSpec.min_securities_per_group already is one and has no default. RUNTIME: a whole-market period's report is 2.7 ms against 58.2 ms for the quantile period it reports on, measured in the same process -- 21x cheaper than its own input -- and a two-period turnover series over 553 holdings a side is 0.7 ms, which closes the one workload ADR-0003's V2-P3-006 section listed as unmeasured. Nothing here is a reduction over a numeric array, so runtime dependencies remain nine. 59 of 59 targeted mutants were killed, including every reported field's own tampering.

feature_name: Immutable factor experiment artifact and the raw/processed/neutralized three-tier report
feature_description: V2-P3-014's experiment artifact as a fifth standard-library leaf over V2-P3-005..008, binding one factor's IC stability, quantile-portfolio returns, rolling turnover and raw-against-tier survival correlation on ALL THREE STORED TIERS into one sealed, content-addressed record. D8 asks that a report compare raw / processed / neutralized performance without overwriting the source observations, and the roadmap's own annotation is the acceptance criterion: without it a reader cannot tell 'the factor works' from 'the exposure was not controlled'. THREE ROWS ARE NOT ENOUGH AND THE GRID IS THE ANSWER: TierAttribution is a first-class record over a declared grid of three tier steps (raw->processed, processed->neutralized, raw->neutralized) times two already oriented statistics (ICSummary.mean_ic, QuantilePortfolioSummary.mean_spread), and each cell carries both tiers' numbers, their ratio and a verdict from a closed six-member vocabulary decided at a DECLARED retention_floor with no default -- so a factor whose neutralized IC collapses to zero reads `removed` in a named cell rather than leaving a reader to compare two numbers. no_baseline is split from removed because a factor whose earlier tier never worked has nothing for the later one to have kept, and reversed from amplified because a step that turns the bet around is not a step that shrank it. IMMUTABILITY IS TWO MECHANISMS AND BOTH ARE ENFORCED: experiment_id is stable_model_id over the declaration and the inputs (the four upstream specs whole, the floor, the code commit, a set_digest of the as_ofs and one per tier of the stored builds read) while content_digest is the same function over the whole document, so ONE experiment_id UNDER TWO content_digests IS NON-DETERMINISM RATHER THAN TWO EXPERIMENTS and refuse_a_restated_experiment refuses it in panel_factors._refuse_to_drop_a_stored_build's shape while admitting an identical re-derivation; and open_experiment recomputes the digest from a reopened payload so a document edited between two processes fails to parse rather than merely differing. built_at and note reach no digest at all, for FactorBuildManifest.built_at's and FactorNote's stated reasons, and both are named in IDENTITY_EXEMPT_PARAMETERS which an audit over the builder's own inspect.signature partitions against. FOUR REFUSAL VOCABULARIES COEXIST BY NOT BEING RECONCILED: every tier row carries its four upstream summaries whole with their own coverage codes and this module adds no fifth spelling of insufficient; the only synthesis is one grid code, not_measured. The neutralised row is read at a year-end snapshot and says so in its own KNOWN_EXPERIMENT_LIMITATIONS entry under the same code V2-P3-005 and V2-P3-006 carry.
notes: THE ACCEPTANCE DEMONSTRATION. One factor over four securities and two as_ofs, driven through all four real upstream studies on all three tiers. The raw and processed tiers rank the cross section perfectly against the realised forward returns (mean rank IC exactly 1.0); the neutralised residuals are the one four-element permutation whose Spearman correlation with the identity is exactly zero, measured off ICSummary.mean_ic with == rather than taken from the rank-difference formula, since factor_ic._pearson computes a scaled product-moment correlation and 'those two agree at the last bit' is a claim about floating point. The artifact then says, in one lookup: raw->processed mean_ic survives at a retention of exactly 1.0, processed->neutralized mean_ic is REMOVED at a retention of exactly 0.0. THE SURVIVAL ROW CORROBORATES IT INDEPENDENTLY -- the processed tier is in rank lockstep with raw (mean_abs_correlation 1.0, verdict undeclared_lockstep, which is what a monotone standardization must produce) and the neutralised tier correlates with raw at exactly 0.0 (verdict distinct), so 'the edge was the exposure' is two independent readings of one artifact rather than one number wearing two hats. THE TWO STATISTICS COME APART ON THE SAME FIXTURE and that is why both are carried: the net long-short spread retains 0.49999999999999445 of itself across the same step, because a two-by-two cut is coarser than an ordering, so the mean_ic cell reads removed and the mean_spread cell reads survives at the declared floor of 0.4 -- and the floor is chosen away from that number on purpose, since a verdict decided by the last bits of two fee-bearing quotients would change its answer when CostSchedule's defaults did. THE PER-FIELD TAMPER AUDIT is the coverage answer: test_every_field_of_a_sealed_record_refuses_to_reopen_after_a_single_edit walks all 335 scalar leaves of the serialised artifact, perturbs exactly one at a time and requires the reopened record to be refused on each, so a field added to any of the four upstream summaries is protected the day it lands without anybody extending a list -- which is the direction 100% line coverage is worth nothing in, and on which V2-P3-006, 007 and 008 between them left twenty surviving mutants. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: no store. backtest/ may not import panel/ or storage/, the factor_* datasets' subject column already means a security or a manifest_id, and V2-P3-002's ParquetEvidenceStore prohibition is a type-and-import-graph argument about FactorObservation that does NOT transfer to a report -- so the honest obstacle is layering, the artifact ships as a canonical JSON document any byte store can hold, and nothing_in_this_module_stores_an_artifact_or_can_be_made_to records what that costs.
